content.text: The insurance clause is present and meets the preferred position in full.

input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: § 18 imposes insurance obligations on Vendor (Copperleaf) and meets the preferred position on every material term: CGL at USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, E&O at USD 2M, and cyber/privacy liability at USD 5M, maintained at Vendor's expense for the term plus one year. § 18.2 adds certificates of insurance on request, reputable insurers, primary coverage where customary, cancellation notice, and confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities — all favourable to us. No redline needed.
